methodNotes: No generic food-class split of total Omega-3 was used to estimate ALA, EPA or DHA.
Exact BLS FAPUN3 zero plus an unreported ALA supports ALA zero; for food 700, BLS total Omega-3 equals measured ALA and potato/oil identity excludes EPA and DHA.
For foods 602, 620 and 625, the BLS total was aligned to directly sourced ALA+EPA+DHA after documented rounding or liquid-density conversion.
BLS values are g per 100 g. Positive values are not transferred to ml-based items without a verified density conversion; exact source zeroes remain zero.
USDA nutrient 619 is used for ALA, 629 for EPA and 621 for DHA. A missing source nutrient is not treated as zero.
Zeros are used only for explicit source zeroes, exactly zero total fat, or plant-only EPA/DHA exclusion.
Any source components that would exceed the database total Omega-3 are withheld and recorded as a conflict rather than adjusted.

Where an exact USDA item profile reports positive Omega-3 but the mapped BLS total was formula-calculated as zero with ALA unreported, the Omega-3 total is corrected to the directly sourced USDA fatty-acid sum and logged below.

omega3Corrections.note: BLS components ALA 0.0168 + EPA 0 + DHA 0.00053 sum to 0.01733 g/100 g; published FAPUN3 0.0173 is lower by rounding, so the total is aligned to the sourced component sum.
Exact BLS ALA 0.041 g/100 g converted by audited same-food density 1.04400795 g/ml; EPA and DHA are BLS zero. The previous total 0 reflected an unconverted liquid value.
